identificationModule.briefTitle: Neoadjuvant Tislelizumab + LM-302 + S-1 or Tislelizumab + SOX for CLDN18.2-Positive Gastric/GEJ Adenocarcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Tislelizumab Combined With LM-302 and S-1 Versus Tislelizumab Combined With SOX for Neoadjuvant Treatment of Claudin 18.2-positive Locally Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma: a Prospective, Randomized, Exploratory Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In this study, the investigators will use Tislelizumab combined with LM-302 and S-1 versus Tislelizumab combined with SOX to treat Claudin 18.2-positive locally advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

primaryOutcomes.description: pCR is defined as the absence of residual tumor based on evaluation of the resected stomach and lymph node specimen according to Becker remission criteria

secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as tumor specimens resected after neoadjuvant therapy with residual tumor cells ≤10%
R0 resection rate was defined as the proportion of patients with complete resection of the tumor and negative margins, i.e. no residual tumors

Event-free survival (EFS) is defined as the time from treatment initiation until the occurrence of any predefined event, including disease progression preventing planned surgery, local or distant recurrence, or death from any cause
Overall survival (OS) is defined as the period from the initial date of neoadjuvant therapy to the date of death due to any cause.
It is defined according to the AJCC 8th edition ypN staging system, with the ypN0 rate and total number of positive lymph nodes in the two groups.
